response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development, but lacks the mandatory C++ development experience on Windows platform (primary skill) and domain expertise in Fixed Income, Fixed Income Derivatives, or Investment Banking/Capital Markets. Most recent roles focus on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and other modern stacks, with no clear evidence of C++ proficiency in recent years.
strengths: Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development)
Extensive full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Proven ability to deliver high-performance, low-latency applications
concerns: No demonstrated C++ development experience on Windows platform in the last 5+ years
No domain expertise in Fixed Income, Investment Banking, or Capital Markets
Primary technical stack does not align with the role's mandatory requirements
